title: Chapter 251 Beat Him
content:
Chapter 251 Beat Him

In his tone, that unique confidence was revealed.

Lu Daosheng can kill him, and so does her.

However, her strength has not yet been fully restored, so she cannot be as scruples as Lu Daosheng.

"Mom, what should we do now?"

Lu Xue asked.

Hearing this, Yan Lingyun smiled faintly and said, "Do whatever you should do. Next, everything will be the same in the deserted city."

Then, Yan Lingyun turned around and looked at Gu Chen and others.

"Do you understand?"

Hearing Yan Lingyun's question, Gu Chen and others were shocked and they all said loudly: "We understand!"

Seeing this, Yan Lingyun nodded slightly.

Although Lu Daosheng is gone, she still has her in Huangcheng.

Looking at the entire fairy world, as long as she is there in the deserted city, no one can shake the deserted city.

Even if I come from the Immortal Emperor!

At this moment, Shi Liantian, who had been silent, moved slightly, stepped forward and bowed, "Madam, that, my alchemy competition?"

Alchemy competition.

Under Lu Daosheng's arrangement, he and Jordanyang have this alchemy competition.

And it's today.

But now, Lu Daosheng has left.

Then does that mean you don’t have to conduct that childish competition anymore?

Shi Liantian thought so in his heart.

But in the end, it still couldn't do it.

Yan Lingyun said in a faint voice: "I said it, everything is the same."

Hearing this, Shi Liantian couldn't help but tremble all over and nodded quickly.

He will never forget, just not long ago, how terrifying the aura he felt.

There is no normal person in the city lord of Huangcheng and the city lord's wife.

All monsters!

Fortunately, their daughters are normal.

Shi Liantian glanced at Lu Xue slightly, not knowing what he was thinking.

"Madam, then we will take our leave first."

Gu Chen stepped forward and clasped his fists.

Since the alchemy competition is going to be on schedule, they will continue to work hard.

Especially An Xing and Awei are the busiest.

I am helping each other.

With Yan Lingyun nodding in agreement, everyone suddenly retreated like a tide, and soon only Yan Lingyun and the two masters and disciples of Shi Liantian were left in front of the hall.

"You two, come in with me."

Yan Lingyun spoke, then turned around and walked into the hall.

Hearing this, Shi Liantian looked at Yuanyuan, who had been obediently beside him and took a deep breath.

At this time, Lu Xue, who was standing beside her, stretched out her hand and smiled, "Please, old man."

Feeling Lu Xue's enthusiasm, Shi Liantian was slightly stunned. Obviously, he didn't expect that this beautiful girl from Heaven would be so polite.

As the saying goes, don’t hit people with smiles.

Shi Liantian also smiled.

"Miss Lu, you're kind."

Inside the hall.

Yan Lingyun saw the scene just now, and the corners of her mouth couldn't help but raise slightly.

It seems that my daughter is quite good to send her to the academy to study.

Look, how long it took for this to change.

When all three of them entered the hall.

Yan Lingyun had already sat in the position where Lu Daosheng often sat.

That represents the pinnacle of the status of the deserted city.

Lu Xue naturally did not stand below, but stood beside Yan Lingyun.

There is only this chair in the entire hall.

Lu Xue once mentioned this to Lu Daosheng, but Lu Daosheng's answer was.

"You are still young and don't understand. This is called the qualities of the superiors."

Lu Xue sneered at this.

She didn't understand why her father was so persistent in pretending.

Could it be that she is really still young?

At this time, Yan Lingyun looked at the master and apprentice below.

"Slaying the Sky."

Yan Lingyun spoke softly.

Shi Liantian below did not dare to neglect at all, "Madam."

"Shi Liantian, I know you were once extraordinary, but I tell you that since you came to Huangcheng, I will not care what you were like."

"If you are sensible, my Huangcheng will treat you well, but if you don't understand,"

Yan Lingyun didn't finish speaking, but her extremely cold eyes stared at Shi Liantian below.

Feeling that threatening and extremely oppressive look, Shi Liantian immediately lowered his head tightly, not daring to breathe.

This is a bit different from what Lord Huang said before!

I've gotten on the pirate ship!

He shouted in his heart, but he kept saying yes.

"Remember below, remember."

"That's great."

Seeing Shi Liantian sweating profusely, Yan Lingyun then withdrew her gaze.

Although this was someone brought back by Lu Daosheng, Yan Lingyun decided to beat him up.

She always felt that Lu Daosheng was sometimes a little indecisive and not ruthless enough.

In that case, even if you have all the strength, your subordinates may not be 100% loyal.

On the side, Lu Xue looked at all this silently.

She basically never asked or intervened in everything her parents did.

Looking at the two masters and disciples of Shi Liantian below, Lu Xue also had a hint of curiosity in her eyes.

I have never heard of Shi Liantian.

When she came back, she was still curious about where the alchemist from her deserted city came from and wanted to compete with the academy Tutor Qiao.

It seems that I have guessed well, and my father really caught an alchemist from outside and came back.

I just don't know how it is.

As for the woman in black dress behind Shi Liantian.

It seems to be as big as myself.

After a long time.

On the way out.

"Old sir, can you win when you compete with Master Qiao?"

Lu Xue followed Shi Liantian and asked curiously.

No matter how much she said this guy was fighting on behalf of their deserted city, she naturally had to care about it.

Hearing Lu Xue’s question, Shi Liantian smiled disdainfully, "Miss Lu, I’m sorry, if it weren’t for the entrusted by the city lord, I would like to compete with me. Oh, I don’t know the world is high!"

"Little devil?!"

Shi Liantian's words made Lu Xue shocked.

Where did my father find the alchemist? This is too crazy.

Although I don’t have any feelings for Jordan Yang, I still have some understanding of Jordan Yang’s deeds.

The master of the Immortal Realm alchemy world, the Immortal Emperor Pill, which is hard to find, is nothing in his hands.

The strong man who wanted to entrust Jordan Yang to refine the elixir could almost fill the entire academy.

But Jordanyang has a bad temper and not everyone has refined elixirs for him.

So this also led to the fact that Jordanyang's pills became extremely valuable in the entire fairyland.

But now, such a powerful alchemy power is just a little devil in the eyes of the old man who looks like a beggar.

Unable to help, Lu Xue looked at Shi Liantian carefully.

Seeing that it was not as if it was bragging, I felt relieved.

"Please take all your strength at that time and let me see the style of this top alchemy master in the fairy world."

Lu Xue said with a smile.

Hearing this, Shi Liantian smiled arrogantly, stroked his beard, and looked up at the void without saying a word.
